items.html: And these are the first nine in the beard of ZA. And from above illuminate El, Rachum, and Chanun, which are three of the thirteen of the head, which are the upper YHV of the beard of Arich Anpin, in Erech, Apayim, and VeRav Chesed, which are three. Thus three upper ones illuminate in these three. Also the three others, which are: VeEmet, Notzer Chesed, LaAlafim, illuminate in the two lower ones of ZA, which are: Nosse Avon, and VaPesha.
